propositions: Whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and incorrectly stale attestations, violating the documented whitespace-normalization invariant.
material_basis() canonicalizes the description but inserts no_file_impact_reason byte-for-byte for file_impact_scope=none, bypassing whitespace normalization.

A normalize_reason parameter must be threaded through material_fingerprint and current_material_fingerprint_impl to normalize insignificant reason whitespace in current paths while preserving raw-reason behavior in all three legacy candidates.
Boundary and trailing whitespace variants of no_file_impact_reason must produce identical current fingerprints and certified verdicts, while interior whitespace or substantive edits remain material.
Pre-330c, post-330c/pre-2be7, and post-2be7/pre-fix legacy candidates must each explicitly disable reason normalization to reproduce their historical byte-exact fingerprints.
